title: A module with a complete devissage that is flat at the point is finitely presented, free over the base and a direct sum of smooth pieces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma draws concrete consequences from the existence of a complete devissage: for a module flat at a prime over the maximal ideal of a local base, it concludes that the module is finitely presented, free over the base, and a direct sum of powers of smooth algebras (statement lines 2425-2440, tag 05I4). The proof runs an induction on the length of the devissage: it first replaces the pair by the first step using the identification of localisations, then applies the induction step to see that the first map is universally injective with flat cokernel so that the induction hypothesis applies to the tail, and finally assembles finite presentation from the extension lemma and freeness from projectivity over the local base. The induction and the assembly are the substance, so the claim is H2.
